Symbols Nerd Font

Huterm embeds SymbolsNerdFont-Regular.ttf from the Nerd Fonts 3.5.1
NerdFontsSymbolsOnly release, unmodified, to draw icon code points that the
configured terminal font does not cover. Nerd Fonts (https://www.nerdfonts.com,
copyright (c) 2014 Ryan L McIntyre) assembled the font from the icon sets
below, rescaling and re-encoding their glyphs to Nerd Fonts code points. Each
set keeps its own license:

- Codicons 0.0.45, copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation, CC BY 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Nerd Fonts repaired glyphs
  U+EA91 and U+EBF0. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons
- Devicons 2.17.0, copyright (c) 2015 konpa, MIT.
  https://github.com/devicons/devicon
- Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 icons, copyright (c) Fonticons, Inc., CC BY 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Nerd Fonts built a subset
  from the release SVGs, which the CC BY 4.0 part of the Font Awesome Free
  license covers, and added the Font Awesome 7.3.1 solid volume icon.
  https://fontawesome.com
- Font Awesome Extension 0.0.3, copyright (c) 2017 André Luiz Gava, MIT.
  https://github.com/AndreLZGava/font-awesome-extension
- Font Logos 1.3.0, released into the public domain under The Unlicense.
  https://github.com/lukas-w/font-logos
- Hack extra glyphs, copyright 2018 Source Foundry Authors, MIT, with
  Bitstream Vera Sans Mono under the Bitstream Vera License.
  https://github.com/source-foundry/Hack
- Material Design Icons (October 6, 2022), Pictogrammers Free License: the
  font is distributed under Apache 2.0. Nerd Fonts repaired glyph U+F1522.
  https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign-Font
- Octicons 18.3.0, copyright (c) 2023 GitHub Inc., MIT.
  https://github.com/primer/octicons
- Seti UI 0.8.1, copyright (c) 2014 Jesse Weed, MIT, and the original Nerd
  Fonts glyphs under the Nerd Fonts MIT license.
  https://github.com/jesseweed/seti-ui
- Pomicons 1.001, copyright (c) 2021 Gabriele Lana, with Reserved Font Name
  Pomicons, SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/gabrielelana/pomicons
- Powerline Extra Symbols 1.200, copyright (c) 2016 Ryan L McIntyre, MIT.
  https://github.com/ryanoasis/powerline-extra-symbols
- Powerline Symbols 1.000, copyright 2013 Kim Silkebækken and other
  contributors, MIT. Nerd Fonts added a 7% strip to the straight side of
  U+E0B0 and U+E0B2.
  https://github.com/powerline/powerline
- IEC Power Symbols, copyright (c) 2013 Joe Loughry, MIT.
  https://github.com/jloughry/Unicode
- Weather Icons 2.0.10, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icon designs originally by
  Lukas Bischoff; icon art for 1.1 onward by Erik Flowers.
  https://github.com/erikflowers/weather-icons

The Pomicons and Weather Icons glyphs in this font remain under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1, whatever license covers the rest of the font. Huterm
distributes the font file unmodified and does not use either reserved name.

Brand icons in these sets are trademarks of their respective owners; these
licenses grant no trademark rights.
